title: Meta Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Meta's Q2 release reports 28% revenue growth, 3.60 billion Family daily active people, 14% ad-impression growth, 12% average-price-per-ad growth, USD 31.08 billion quarterly capital expenditures, and only USD 784 million quarterly free cash flow. It guides Q3 revenue to USD 61-64 billion, 2026 expenses to USD 165-169 billion, and 2026 capital expenditures to USD 130-145 billion.
